annotations.title: Name the account a place’s money is shown by

description: Say which account each place on Net worth is — the bank account, the broker, the savings account whose statements show its money — **several in one call**. A place *links* to an account and is not merged with it: a deposit or cash at home has no statements and names none (`account: null` takes a link away). A card cannot be named, and an account is named by one place at most. The account gets its own cash holding in the place, made with the link — or `cash_holding` picks one already there, such as the holding goal deposits already land in. Unlinking keeps the holding. A bank account or cash has a place named as it and its own cash from the moment it is made; naming it from another place moves it there while its own place holds nothing. A place that names one account is not re-pointed to another in one call: set it to `null` first. Nothing here moves a figure. Places and holdings are listed by `savings`; accounts by `document_info`. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

links.description: One entry per place. Up to 60 in a call.

account.description: The account, by id or by name; null to name none.

cash_holding.description: Optional: a holding already in the place, by id or name, to be the account’s cash instead of a new one.

place.description: The place, by id or by name.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
